mainEntity.name: How much CO₂ does a car emit per mile?

acceptedAnswer.text: A gasoline car at 26 mpg emits about 342 g of CO₂ per mile. Each US gallon of gasoline burned releases 8,887 g of CO₂.

mainEntity.name: How many trees offset a car?

acceptedAnswer.text: By the EPA equivalency, one urban tree seedling grown for 10 years absorbs 0.060 tonnes of CO₂, so a typical car needs about 68 seedlings for a year of driving.

mainEntity.name: Why does the offset price vary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Offset prices depend on the project type and quality. The default of $15 per tonne is only a placeholder. Enter the price you are quoted.
